g.text: [E4. small talk or out of scope]

text.tspan: J. Every step above is a LangSmith span tagged user, role, session

svg.text: signed JWT (sub, name, role, department, exp)
Pydantic checks the body (empty or too long → 400)
load saved state for this thread
refusal → go to finalize (skip D to H)
SSE route event with one-line reason
dense + sparse in parallel, filter access_rank ≤ clearance
reranked order (fused order if the reranker fails)
keep top 8, at most 2 chunks per doc
code model writes a Python plan
AST check (imports, dunder names, banned calls)
start child (no keys, no network, CPU and memory limits)
init line (code, primitive names, allowed imports)
same filter, clearance from the user session (no rerank)
reply (hidden docs look like missing docs)
done with result, then the child is killed
keep only chunk ids the parent really returned
fast model analyses batch 1 to N
main model joins findings → common themes
plan again with the follow-up question
main model → ToolPlan, only allowed tools shown
up to 3 calls, each with a reason
check role again + Pydantic args (no extra fields)
admin only, thread must have a pending approval
response(chunks or findings or tool results)
sanitiser removes instructions, wraps text as data
main model streams the answer with citations
every citation must match a retrieved chunk
output guard (no advice, no secrets, brand voice)
update_memory: fast model summarises if over 12 messages
